title: Compare Generative, Agentic and Agent AI for Finance
acceptance: Every use case has a type, a justification, a highest-impact action, a named control and an accountable owner; the three selected are justified on control readiness.

title: Draft a Financial Report with Copilot in Word
acceptance: Every figure in the report matches the source workbook exactly; causal claims are evidenced or labelled as hypotheses; the report names its period and as-at date.

title: Build a Financial Presentation and an M365 Finance Agent
acceptance: Repeated figures reconcile across workbook, report and deck; the agent cites a source document and its effective date, and refuses an out-of-scope question instead of guessing.

title: Prepare Finance Data for Copilot in Excel
acceptance: Duplicate count is zero, required-field errors are zero, cleaned totals reconcile to the control figures, and the before-and-after Copilot answers are documented.

title: Analyse Variances and Build a Dashboard with Copilot
acceptance: All formula checks pass; total variance equals actual less budget; charts stay linked to source data; commentary separates evidenced fact from labelled hypothesis.

title: Reconcile Accounts and Forecast with Copilot
acceptance: Matched plus exception values reconcile to both sources; every unresolved item has a reason, age and owner; scenarios are driven by assumption cells; escalation items above the policy threshold are flagged.

title: Build the Finance SharePoint Site and Load Finance Data
acceptance: Both libraries and all seven lists exist with correct column types; row counts match the data pack; loaded data reconciles to the control totals; the permission review names each group and its justification.

title: Ground a Finance Agent and Test Its Refusals
acceptance: The agent cites the correct document and effective date on positive tests; refuses on out-of-scope, unsupported and approval requests; the UAT log records evidence for every case; web search is removed.

title: Create the Environment and a Finance Agent Flow
acceptance: The environment exists with Dataverse and a billing plan; the flow is published and runs green; the run history shows the SharePoint action returning rows; the flow appears as a tool on the agent.

title: Add a Human Approval Gate to a Finance Workflow
acceptance: The gate blocks until a person responds; both approval and rejection paths are evidenced; the draft is logged before the gate; the default is fail-safe and the learner can explain why.

title: Orchestrate a Multi-Agent Month-End Close
acceptance: Each routing test reaches the correct specialist; the supervisor preserves specialist figures and caveats; a missing-data case is reported as blocked rather than answered; no agent can approve, post or send.

title: Secure a Finance Agent for PDPA and Human Oversight
acceptance: Every high risk has a preventive and a detective control with test evidence; the PDPA review is complete with a named DPO; no restricted data is in scope; adversarial tests are evidenced; the recommendation names a residual risk and an accountable owner.
